title: KS McCrae Somatic Lexicon — Runtime Payload v2.0
description: Schema for master_lexicon.json. All fields are structured for direct AI Agents API consumption.

registers.description: 5 gender registers (female, male, shared, TF, TM)

fluids.description: 19 fluid entries. Each has _fluid_type field. _by_type groups by staging/atmospheric/blend/trace/parallel

validation.description: Compiled validation. banned_terms_flat = sorted list for O(log n) lookup.

banned_terms_flat.description: All absolute banned terms, lowercase, sorted

primitives.description: Extracted primitives from all registers for fast lookup

_allowed_by_register.description: Flat allowed-term lists per register for vocabulary validation
